αἰγιόχοιο: αἰγίοχος — aegis-bearing, epithet of Zeus (meaning disputed, usually ’holding the αἰγίς’); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
αἰπὺν: αἰπύς — steep, sheer, high; masc. acc. sg.
αἰτωλῶν: Αἰτωλοί — the Aetolians; masc. gen. pl.
αἰὲν: αἰεί — always, ever; adv., epic by-form αἰέν (Attic ἀεί)
αἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl. · also demonstrative ὁ, ἡ, τό (in Homer a pronoun), fem. nom. pl.: ’they’; αἳ μέν … αἳ δέ ’some … others’ · also fem. nom. pl. with a dual verb (a dual subject, two goddesses): ’the two’
αὐτίκ: αὐτίκα (elided αὐτίκ’) — at once, immediately; adv.
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg.: ’of himself, him’ · also the adverb αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot’
αὐτόθ: αὐτόθι — right there, on the spot; adv., elided (αὐτόθ’ = αὐτόθι)
αὐτός: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’he himself’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg., intensive with the subject: ’myself, yourself, himself’
αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg., as a plain pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ) · also intensive: ’himself’ · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun with no preposition, indirect object: ’to him’ (ἥρμοσε … αὐτῷ ’fitted him’)
αὖθ: αὖθις (elided αὖθ’) — again, in turn, next; adv., epic by-form αὖθι (cf. αὖτε)
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βοὴν: βοή — shout, war-cry; fem. acc. sg. of respect: ’good at the war-cry’ (βοὴν ἀγαθός)
βροτολοιγὸς: βροτολοιγός — ruinous to mortals, man-destroying (epithet of Ares); masc. nom. sg.
βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γένος: γένος — stock, race, breed; neut. nom. sg. (ἡμιόνων γένος ’the breed of mules’)
γαίων: γαίω — exult, glory (in); pres. part. masc. nom. sg., + dat. of the thing gloried in
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γείνατο: γείνομαι — beget, bear (of a mother); aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented (= ἐγείνατο) · also of a father: ’begot, fathered’
γλαυκῶπις: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena: ’gleaming-eyed’ (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
δέος: δέος — fear, dread; neut. nom. sg.
δίφρον: δίφρος — chariot-board, chariot; masc. acc. sg. · also a seat, stool: ’stool’ (δίφρον … κατέθηκε ’set down a stool’)
δαίμονι: δαίμων — divinity, god, divine power; masc. dat. sg.
δηρὸν: δηρόν — for a long time, long; neut. acc. sg. used as adv. (accusative of duration)
διομήδεα: Διομήδης — Diomedes, king of Argos; masc. acc. sg., epic -εα (= Attic -η)
διομήδεος: Διομήδης — Diomedes, son of Tydeus, Greek hero at Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
διομήδεϊ: Διομήδης — Diomedes, son of Tydeus, king of Argos; masc. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic -ει)
διομήδης: Διομήδης — Diomedes, king of Argos; masc. nom. sg.
διόμηδες: Διομήδης — Diomedes, son of Tydeus; masc. voc. sg.
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis · also + acc., ’through, in (three parts)’ (διὰ τρίχα ’in three parts’)
διὶ: Ζεύς — Zeus, chief of the gods; masc. dat. sg. Διί
δόρυ: δόρυ — wood, tree-trunk; spear (a shaft of wood); neut. nom./acc. sg. (gen. δουρός)
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖον: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; standing epithet; masc. acc. sg.
δῶμα: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; neut. acc. sg.
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question · εἰ δή ’if indeed, since’ · also εἰ δ’ ἄγε ’come now’, a hortatory idiom
εἰμι: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 sg., enclitic (accent goes to the word before): ’I am’
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also + acc. of respect: ’in’ (εἰς ὦπα ’in face’)
εἰσ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., elided (εἰσ’ = εἰσί): ’are’
εἴ: εἰ — if, whether; accented εἴ before an enclitic (εἴ κεν, εἴ ποτε, εἴ περ)
εἵματα: εἷμα — garment, clothing; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’clothes’
εἷλεν: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (= εἷλε): ’seized’ · also ’killed’, of a warrior who takes a man’s life (Κοίρανον εἷλεν ’killed Coeranus’)
εὐρύν: εὐρύς — wide, broad; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οὐρανόν, set after its noun
ζεύς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ζυγὸν: ζυγόν — yoke; neut. acc. sg., after ὑπό in tmesis with ἤγαγεν: ’under the yoke’
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before a rough breathing) — and; connective particle
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θεοῖσι: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic θεοῖς)
θεὰ: θεά — goddess; nom. sg. · also voc. sg. in address: ’goddess!’
θοῦρον: θοῦρος — rushing, impetuous, furious; masc. acc. sg., epithet of Ares
θυμόν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul, anger; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ἀποπνείων ’breathing out his life’)
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ὀλέσσῃ ’lose his life’)
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
καθέζετο: καθέζομαι — sit down; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐκαθέζετο)
καλὸν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with παιήονα: ’a fair (paean)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with εἶδος: ’fair’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a noun standing for a person: ’a fine (one)’ (καλὸν … ἴδον ’a fine one … I saw’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ζυγόν: ’a fair (yoke)’
καρπῷ: καρπός — wrist; masc. dat. sg. · also καρπός — fruit, produce; masc. dat. sg.
καρτερὰ: καρτερός — strong, mighty; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἔργα
καταθνητός: καταθνητός — liable to death, mortal (= Attic θνητός); masc. nom. sg.
καταρρέον: καταρρέω (κατά + ῥέω) — flow down; pres. part. act. neut. acc. sg., agreeing with αἷμα: ’flowing down’
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); with the subj. in purpose and general clauses · also + subj. in a temporal or conditional clause: ’whenever’, ’if’ · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’shall’ (κε μελήσεται ’will concern’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (τώ κε … ἠμύσειε ’then would collapse’)
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would be’ (κεν … κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would be better’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after εἰς ὅ: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … μάχωνται ’until they fight’)
κενεῶνα: κενεών — flank, the hollow of the body between ribs and hip; masc. acc. sg., acc. of the part struck
κεχαρισμένε: χαρίζομαι — show favour, gratify; perf. pass. part. masc. voc. sg., + dat.: ’dear to, well-pleasing to’
κεῖσθαι: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; pres. inf. mid. dep.: ’to lie’
κοιρανέοντα: κοιρανέω — rule, be lord, command; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κοιρανοῦντα)
κούρην: κούρη — girl, daughter (epic = Attic κόρη); fem. acc. sg.
κρατερὸς: κρατερός — mighty, strong; adj., masc. nom. sg.
κρονίωνι: Κρονίων — son of Cronus, i.e. Zeus; masc. dat. sg.
κυνέην: κυνέη — helmet, cap; fem. acc. sg., epic -έην (= Attic κυνῆν)
κύδεϊ: κῦδος — glory, majesty; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic -ει), dat. of cause after γαίων
κύπριδα: Κύπρις — Cypris, i.e. Aphrodite; fem. acc. sg.
λάζετο: λάζομαι — take hold of, seize, take; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐλάζετο)
λαβοῦσα: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg. (+ gen., of the part taken): ’having taken hold’
λευκὸν: λευκός — white, bright; neut. acc. sg.
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάν: μάν — truly, indeed; epic particle (Doric form of μήν), ἄγρει μάν ’come now’
μάχαι: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. nom. pl.
μάχεσθαι: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. inf. (Attic μάχεσθαι), + dat. ’fight against’ · also with ἀμφί + dat. of the cause: ’fight over’ (ἀμφ’ Ἑλένῃ … μάχεσθαι ’to fight over Helen’)
μάχην: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. acc. sg., object of καταδύμεναι: ’the fighting’ · also fem. acc. sg., after ἀνά (ἄν τε μάχην): ’through the fighting’
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, rage; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’might’
μή: μή — not; the negative of wish, command, fear and condition (where οὐ is the negative of fact) · also ’lest’, with the subj. · also ’lest’ with the opt. (μή … δευοίατο ’lest they lack’) · also ’lest’ with a dual verb in -ετον: ’lest the two … hang back’
μήτε: μήτε — nor, and not; negative conj. with imperatives, correlative: ’neither … nor’
μακάρεσσι: μάκαρ — blessed, happy (epithet of the gods); masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -σι)
μεγάλοιο: μέγας — great, big; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
μεμαὼς: μέμαα (μάω) — strive, be eager; perf. part. masc. nom. sg., epic, present sense (no Attic equivalent): ’eager’
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; + dat./acc./gen. · also an adverb, ’among them’, or a preverb in tmesis
μηδ: μηδέ — and not, nor; conj., elided (μηδ’ = μηδέ), with an imperative: ’and do not’ · also with an optative of wish: ’and let … not’ (μηδ’ ἔτι … εἴην ’and may I no longer be’) · also with a hortatory subj.: ’and let us not’ (μηδ’ … ἀμβαλλώμεθα ’and let us not put off’)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., accented μοί before the enclitic that follows: ’to me, for me’
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of possession or interest: ’my’ (μοι ἵπποι ’my horses’)
μώνυχας: μώνυξ — solid-hoofed, with an undivided hoof; masc. acc. pl., agreeing with ἵππους
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
νείατον: νείατος — lowest, last; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic νέατος)
νεμεσίζῃ: νεμεσίζομαι — feel resentment at, be indignant at (+ dat.); pres. 2 sg. mid. -ῃ: οὐ νεμεσίζῃ ’do you not resent?’
νεφεληγερέτα: νεφεληγερέτα — epithet of Zeus: ’cloud-gatherer’ (νεφέλη ’cloud’ + ἀγείρω ’gather’); masc. nom. sg., old -α form
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐλομένην: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. part. mid. οὐλόμενος used as adj., ’accursed, ruinous’; fem. acc. sg.
οὐρανιώνων: Οὐρανίων — son of Uranus, god of heaven (Οὐρανίωνες, the heavenly gods); masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’of the gods of heaven’
οὐρανὸν: οὐρανός — heaven, sky; masc. acc. sg.
οὐτάμεν: οὐτάζω — wound, stab; aor. inf. act., epic athematic -μεν (= Attic οὐτάσαι): ’to wound’
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτέ: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj., accented οὔτέ before an enclitic
οὔτασε: οὐτάω — wound (by a thrust), stab; aor. 3 sg. act.
οὖτα: οὐτάω — wound, stab; aor. 3 sg., epic, without augment: ’stabbed’
πάλαι: πάλαι — long ago, of old; adv.
πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάσσων: πάσσω — sprinkle; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic σσ (= Attic πάττων): ’sprinkling’
πάσχειν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; pres. inf.: ’to suffer’
παιήων: Παιήων — Paieon, physician of the gods (Attic Παιάν); masc. nom. sg.
παλλὰς: Παλλάς — Pallas, a title of Athena; fem. nom. sg.
παραὶ: παρά (epic παραί) — beside, along; prep. + acc.: ’beside’
πελώριον: πελώριος — huge, monstrous; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄνδρα: ’huge’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔγχος: ’huge’
πολέμοιο: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πολέμῳ: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. dat. sg.
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
προφρονέως: προφρονέως — readily, willingly, eagerly; adv. of πρόφρων (-έως = Attic -όνως)
πρόσθεν: πρόσθεν — before, formerly; adv. · also prep. + gen., ’in front of’ (πρόσθεν ἕθεν ’in front of him’)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’) · also adv., ’besides’ (πρὸς δ’ … ῥῆξε ’and besides … broke’) · also prep. + dat.: ’on, against’ (πρὸς χρυσῇ περόνῃ ’on a golden brooch’)
πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’ · also masc. acc. sg., of an arrow: ’winged’
πόλεμοί: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. nom. pl. (accented before the enclitic that follows)
πόλεμον: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, grave before another word) — beside, alongside; prep. + dat.: ’beside’ · also prep. + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ ποταμὸν ’beside the river’) · also prep. + gen., ’from beside’ (πὰρ Διὸς ’from Zeus’) · also adverb, ’beside him’ · also adverb, no case: ’beside, alongside’ (πὰρ δὲ … ἕστασαν ’and beside … stood’)
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’
σθένελον: Σθένελος — Sthenelus, son of Capaneus, Diomedes’ companion and charioteer; masc. acc. sg.
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
σπουδῇ: σπουδή — haste, effort; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’in haste, with effort’
σχεδὸν: σχεδόν — near, close by; adv. (also + gen./dat.)
σύ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg., accented before the enclitic πέρ · also nom. sg., accented before the enclitic γε: εἰ δὲ σύ γ’ ’but if you’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’
τάδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’in this way’ (τάδε μαίνεται ’rages like this’) · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun: ’this’ (τάδε τόξα ’this bow’)
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, accented τέ before the enclitic μιν · also accented before the enclitic οἱ (ἀτάρ τέ οἱ ὄζοι ’but its branches’, τε being the epic particle of what is always so, not translated) · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it, accented before an enclitic: ἦ τέ σ’ ὀΐω ’I truly suspect you’
τήν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. acc. sg. · also relative, ’whom, which’; accented before an enclitic
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’)
ταχέες: ταχύς — swift, fast; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ταχεῖς)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τευ: τις, τι — someone, something; indefinite pron., masc./fem. gen. sg., epic τευ (= Attic τινός)
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’)
τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with τιμήν: ’whatever’ (ἥν τιν’ ἔοικεν ’whatever is fitting’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοίη: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; fem. nom. sg.: ’such a one’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὔνεκα: τοὔνεκα (crasis of τοῦ ἕνεκα) — for this reason, therefore; adv.
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’
τοῖος: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. nom. sg. (τοῖος ... οἷον ’such as’)
τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl.: ’to the others’ (τοῖς ἄλλοις) · also masc. dat. pl., ’to them’ (τοῖς … μύθων ἦρχε ’led the talk before them’)
τοῦτον: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. acc. sg.: ’this man’
τρωσὶ: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρόμος: τρόμος — trembling, quaking; masc. nom. sg.
τρώεσσιν: Τρῶες — Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρῶάς: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. acc. pl., accent shifted before the enclitic τε (Τρῶας θ’)
τυδέος: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. gen. sg. (Τυδέος υἱός ’son of Tydeus’, periphrasis for Diomedes)
τυδεΐδη: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. voc. sg., in address
τυδεΐδῃ: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. dat. sg. (patronymic)
τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’, often with γε: ’that at least’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τό τε εἶδος ’and the looks’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg., inner object: ’which’ (ἕλκος τό μιν βάλε ’the wound with which he struck him’)
τόσον: τόσος — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’only so far’ · also correlative with ὅσον, neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’so loudly, so much’
τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε) · also dual relative: ’the two who’ (τώ οἱ ἔσαν κήρυκε ’the two who were his heralds’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), ’therefore, so’ · also dual acc. relative: ’whom (the two)’ (τώ μοι … γείνατο ’whom … bore for me’)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’)
φάρμακα: φάρμακον — drug, potion (healing or harmful); neut. nom./acc. pl.
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φέροντες: φέρω — carry, bear, bring; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’bringing’
φίλη: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’dear (bride)’
φαίνεται: φαίνω — show, make appear; pres. mid./pass. 3 sg.: ’appears, is plain to see’
χάλκεος: χάλκεος — of bronze, bronze; adj., masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκοῦς)
χάριν: χάρις — grace, favour, thanks; fem. acc. sg.: ’thanks’
χαλκείῳ: χάλκειος — of bronze, bronze-tipped; masc./neut. dat. sg.
χαμᾶζε: χαμᾶζε — to the ground, down to earth; adv. (χαμαί + -δε)
χεῖρ: χείρ — hand; fem. acc. sg., elided (χεῖρ’ = χεῖρα)
χρόα: χρώς — skin, flesh, complexion; masc. acc. sg. χρόα
ἀΐδηλον: ἀΐδηλος — destructive, baneful (exact sense debated); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἀγαθὸς: ἀγαθός — good, brave, noble; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἀγλαὸν: ἀγλαός — splendid, bright, radiant; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἀγορεύων: ἀγορεύω — speak, address, say; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’speaking’
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθανάτοισι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀθανάτων: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; gen. pl., as a noun, partitive: ’of the immortals’ · also adj., gen. pl. agreeing with a noun: ’immortal’ (ἀθανάτων … θεῶν ’of the immortal gods’)
ἀκήριον: ἀκήριος — spiritless, faint-hearted (ἀ- + κῆρ ’heart’; the sense is inferred); neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δέος
ἀλαλκομενηῒς: Ἀλαλκομενηΐς — of Alalcomenae (a Boeotian town), epithet of Athena; fem. nom. sg.
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλλήλοισιν: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις): ’to one another’
ἀλλήλων: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., gen. pl., after πλησίον: ’one another’ · also gen. pl., possessive, dependent on a noun: ’one another’s’ (ἀλλήλων … στήθεσσι ’one another’s chests’) · also gen. pl., governed by ἀντίον: ’one another’ (ἀντίον ἀλλήλων ’face to face with one another’)
ἀνέρες: ἀνήρ — man; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄνδρες)
ἀντικρὺ: ἀντικρύ — straight through, right through; adv. (epic, = ἀντικρύς)
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; + acc. (ἀνὰ στρατόν ’throughout the army’) · + dat., ’upon’ (ἀνὰ σκήπτρῳ ’upon a sceptre’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis: ’up, aboard’ (ἀνὰ … εἷσεν ’set aboard’) · also + acc. in ἀνὰ στόμ’ ἔχων ’having on your lips, going on about’
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀρήξειν: ἀρήγω — help, aid, + dat.; fut. inf.
ἀργείη: Ἀργεῖος — Argive; adj., fem. nom. sg., epic -είη (= Attic Ἀργεία)
ἀργείοισιν: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀργείους: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀφ: ἀπό — from, away from; prep. + gen., elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (ἀφ’ = ἀπό)
ἀφροδίτη: Ἀφροδίτη — Aphrodite, goddess of love; fem. nom. sg.
ἀχαιούς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. pl.: ’which’
ἄγ: ἄγε (elided ἄγ’) — come!, come now; interjection, originally 2 sg. imper. of ἄγω ’lead’, used before another imperative
ἄγεν: ἄγω — lead, take, bring; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, movable ν (= ἦγεν) · also ἄγνυμι — break; aor. 2 pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐάγησαν): ’were bent, broken back’ (of arrow-barbs)
ἄλγε: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl. (ἄλγεα, elided ἄλγε’)
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄλλοις: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. dat. pl.: ’(to) the others’
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
ἄλλους: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. pl.
ἄμβροτον: ἄμβροτος — deathless, immortal (ἀ- + βροτός); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄρηα: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρη) · also by metonymy ’war’ (πολύδακρυν Ἄρηα ’tearful war’)
ἄρηος: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄρηος (= Attic Ἄρεως)
ἄρης: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. nom. sg.
ἄρηϊ: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρει)
ἄριστον: ἀγαθός — good; superl. ἄριστος, masc. acc. sg.: ’best’ · also neut. acc. sg.: ’the best (thing)’ (μέγ’ ἄριστον ’by far the best’)
ἄφρονα: ἄφρων — senseless, foolish; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τοῦτον
ἄϊδος: Ἅιδης (Ἄϊς) — Hades; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄϊδος (Attic Ἅιδου)
ἆτος: ἄατος — insatiable (the traditional sense; formation uncertain), + gen. of what; masc. nom. sg., contracted epic ἆτος
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐμεῦ: ἐγώ — I; gen. sg., epic (= Attic ἐμοῦ)
ἐμοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., stressed (non-enclitic): ’to me’
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’) · also dat. governed by ὑπό: ’under me’ (ὑπ’ ἐμοὶ δμηθέντα ’subdued under me’)
ἐμῷ: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνάριζε: ἐναρίζω — strip a slain foe of his arms, slay; impf. 3 sg.: ’kept stripping, slaying’
ἐνθάδε: ἐνθάδε — hither, to this place; adv. of motion · also ’here, in this place’ (ἐνθάδε μιμνόντεσσι ’for those who stay here’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐξαίνυτο: ἐξαίνυμαι — take out, take away; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented: ’took away (his life)’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’)
ἐπέεσσι: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἔπεσι)
ἐπέσσυτο: ἐπισεύομαι — rush upon, hasten at; aor. 3 sg. mid. dep., epic -σσ- (ἐπ-έσσυτο): ’rushed on’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’)
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐρεβεννὴ: ἐρεβεννός — dark, murky; fem. nom. sg.
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσσί: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’
ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
ἐτέτυκτο: τεύχω — make, contrive, bring about; pass. come to pass, happen; plup. pass. 3 sg.: ’had been made, had come about’
ἐτώσιον: ἐτώσιος — vain, fruitless; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’in vain’
ἐφετμέων: ἐφετμή — command, injunction, behest; fem. gen. pl., epic -έων (= Attic -ῶν), after λήθετο
ἔα: ἐάω — let be, allow, leave alone; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’leave alone!’ · also εἰμί — be; impf. 1 sg., epic ἔα (= Attic ἦν): ’I was’ · also ἐάω — allow; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= εἴα): ’allowed’
ἔασε: ἐάω — let be, leave alone, allow; aor. 3 sg., epic (= Attic εἴασε)
ἔβαινε: βαίνω — go, step, get into; impf. 3 sg.: ’was stepping, got in’
ἔβραχε: βράχω — crash, clang, roar; aor. 3 sg. act., strong aorist
ἔγχεϊ: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic ἔγχει)
ἔλθῃσ: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σι ending (ἔλθῃσι), elided: ’should she come’
ἔπασχον: πάσχω — suffer, experience; impf. 3 pl.: ’were suffering’
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
ἔργῳ: ἔργον — deed, action; neut. dat. sg., dat. of means: ’by deed’ · also after ἐπί: ’task, undertaking’
ἔριδα: ἔρις — strife, rivalry, contest; fem. acc. sg.
ἔρις: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contest; fem. nom. sg.
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold, keep’
ἔχθιστος: ἔχθιστος — most hateful; superl. of ἐχθρός, masc. nom. sg.
ἔχοντα: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’having, holding’ · also with ἄλγεα: ’suffering, enduring’ · also of clothing: ’wearing’
ἕδος: ἕδος — seat, abode; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠκέσατ: ἀκέομαι — heal, cure; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἠκέσατ’ = ἠκέσατο): ’healed’
ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἠμείβετ’ = ἠμείβετο)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’)
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει)
ἤ: ἤ — truly, indeed; asseverative particle (= ἦ), as printed in ἤ τοι, with τοι ’to you’ · also ἤ = εἰ, ’whether’, in an indirect question (ἴδηται ἤ ῥά τί οἱ … ἦε καὶ οὐκί) · also ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (ἠὲ … ἤ ’either … or’)
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥβη: Ἥβη — Hebe, cupbearer of the gods, daughter of Zeus and Hera; fem. nom. sg.
ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form) in address: ’Hera!’
ἥρῃ: Ἥρη — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. dat. sg. Ἥρῃ (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’)
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἰθὺς: ἰθύς — straight; adv. (epic = Attic εὐθύς): ’straight on’ · also prep. + gen.: ’straight towards’
ἰόντες: εἶμι — go, come; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’going, coming’
ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱπποδάμοιο: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming (standing epithet); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἴδε: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδε): ’saw’
ἴδοι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a past general relative clause: ’whom he might see’
ἴσχει: ἴσχω — hold, hold back, restrain (intensive of ἔχω); pres. 3 sg.
ἵκανε: ἱκάνω — come to, reach; impf. 3 sg.: ’came to, reached’
ἶσος: ἴσος — equal, like (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg., epic ἶσος
ὀΐω: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. (act. form ὀΐω, epic; = Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’
ὀδυνήφατα: ὀδυνήφατος — pain-killing (usual explanation: ὀδύνη + a root ’kill’, cf. ἔπεφνον; not certain); neut. acc. pl.
ὀλύμπῳ: Ὄλυμπος (epic Οὔλυμπος) — Olympus, mountain home of the gods; masc. dat. sg.
ὀξέϊ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic ὀξέϊ (= Attic ὀξεῖ)
ὁμοῦ: ὁμοῦ — together, together with, at the same place; adv.
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄλυμπον: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg.
ὄχ: ὄχα — by far, exceedingly; adv., elided (ὄχ’ = ὄχα), intensifying a superlative (ὄχ’ ἄριστα ’far the best’)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; masc. nom. pl.
ὑπόδρα: ὑπόδρα — with a scowl, ’from under the brows’ (ancient explanation; derivation uncertain); adv.
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + gen.: ’on behalf of’ (ὑπὲρ Δαναῶν) · also + acc., ’beyond’ (ὑπὲρ αἶσαν ’beyond due measure’) · also + gen. of place, ’above’ (στέρνον ὑπὲρ μαζοῖο ’the breast above the nipple’) · also + acc. of motion, ’over’ (ὑπὲρ ὦμον ’over the shoulder’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς)
ὠτειλῆς: ὠτειλή — wound; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic -ῆς)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’)
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ὦσε: ὠθέω — push, thrust; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔωσε): ’thrust’
ὧδ: ὧδε — thus, so, in this way; adv., elided (ὧδ’ = ὧδε)
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
